title: T01 — Define the DevTracker v2 metric contract
description:
## Objective

Create the normative metric contract so approximations are never presented as exact measurements of productivity or quality.

## Definition of done

All checklist items are completed, relevant automated tests pass, documentation is updated where behavior changes, and no unrelated workspace changes are introduced.

> DevTracker 2.0 backlog item T01.

checklist.text: Document the name, unit, scope, source, and precision of every metric
Rename keystrokes, pasteEvents, filesTouched, and line churn
Define active time, inactivity, flow block, and context switch
Remove unsupported interpretations of productivity or quality
Define which legacy metrics will be marked as approximate
Create numerical examples and acceptance criteria
